customManagers.description: Pinned Rust toolchain (#1255): services/rust-hid/rust-toolchain.toml, mirrored by the rust:<version>-slim Dockerfile base

packageRules.description: Rust toolchain pin and rust-hid Dockerfile base move together (#1255); the Dockerfile tag must equal rust-toolchain.toml
prBodyNotes: Keep `services/rust-hid/rust-toolchain.toml` and the `rust:<version>-slim` base in `services/rust-hid/Dockerfile` on the same version.

packageRules.description: Group the OpenTelemetry Python suite — versions are interdependent
Group OpenFeature SDK + providers + hooks (co-constrained, see flagd provider 0.5.0 bump)

protobuf/gRPC toolchain: generated code is COMMITTED (proto/*_pb2.py, services/agent/gen). Regenerate via `make protos-all` + `make protos-agent` when grpcio-tools/protobuf move; `ci-validate-protos` gates Python stub drift and `ci-validate-agent-protos` gates Go stub drift.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Generated proto code is committed. If `grpcio-tools` or `protobuf` changed, run `make protos-all` (and `make protos-agent` for the Go agent stubs) and commit the regenerated output before merging — the `Validate Protos & Packages` CI job gates drift of both.

packageRules.description: Group buf.build generated flagd Go modules (move together)
GitHub Actions in one weekly PR; digests pinned via helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests (setup-uv needs exact tags — see PR #763 gotchas)

flagd image + flagd providers must move TOGETHER (flag-set selector coupling, #843: providers >= 0.3.0 silently default against flagd < flagd-selector-header support). Group them so Renovate proposes coordinated bumps; the integration suite is the gate (silent-defaults failure mode).
Majors need explicit approval via the dependency dashboard
